strapiBlog.short_description: Golf Edge is an exclusive off-plan development by Emaar Properties, situated within the prestigious Emaar South community.

data.text:
Golf Edge is an exclusive off-plan development by Emaar Properties, situated within the prestigious Emaar South community. This exceptional project offers a selection of luxurious apartments and townhouses, epitomizing upscale living amidst verdant landscapes and world-class amenities. Designed to provide residents with an unparalleled lifestyle, Golf Edge Dubai seamlessly blends modern architecture with the tranquility of nature, creating a harmonious environment for discerning homeowners.

Luxury Living at Golf Edge Emaar South: What to Expect?

Location

Strategically located in the heart of Emaar South, Golf Edge boasts seamless connectivity to major thoroughfares, including the Emirates Road (E611). This prime positioning ensures residents have effortless access to Dubai's key areas, including Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina while enjoying the serenity of a suburban setting. Proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport further enhances the convenience for frequent travelers.

Properties

Golf Edge properties include an exquisite collection of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments and exclusive 3-bedroom townhouses, each thoughtfully designed to cater to the needs of modern families and professionals. The residences feature contemporary aesthetics, open-plan layouts, and high-quality finishes, ensuring a sophisticated living experience. Expansive windows and private balconies offer panoramic views of the lush fairways and landscaped parks, fostering a sense of openness and tranquility.

Amenities

Residents of Golf Edge Dubai are afforded a plethora of world-class amenities that promote a balanced and active lifestyle. The development encompasses an 18-hole golf course, a state-of-the-art clubhouse, outdoor gyms, yoga decks, and scenic jogging tracks, catering to fitness enthusiasts. Families can relish in the swimming pools, children's play areas, and community parks, providing ample opportunities for leisure and recreation. A retail plaza within the community ensures that daily necessities and indulgent shopping experiences are just moments away.

Payment Plan and Completion

Golf Edge at Emaar South offers an attractive 80/20 payment plan, making investment accessible and convenient. Buyers can secure their unit with a 10% down payment, followed by 70% in staggered installments during the construction phase. The remaining 20% is due upon handover, ensuring a structured and manageable payment process. The project is set for completion and handover in February 2029.
